### Release Notes:
- [x] Added new functions `HashText` and `HashFile`, which can be used to compute the cryptographic hash of the given file or string
- [x] Added new functions `ValidFileName` and `ValidPathSpec`, which can be used to test if a string is a valid file name or a valid full path
- [x] Added new function `AppendToFile`, which can be used to append the contents of one file to another (existing) file
- [x] Added new function `TestParameter`, which can be used to test whether a specific parameter is present on the command-line
- [x] Added new functions `ParameterCnt` and `ParameterStr`, which can be used to access the "raw" command-line tokens (like `argv[i]`)
- [x] Added new functions `TimerCreate` and `TimerDestroy`, which can be used to create a new window timer or stop an existing one.
